description: Five Capella pages state access requirements using Couchbase Server's RBAC role names (query_select, query_manage_system_catalog, query_use_sequences, query_use_sequential_scans), which are documented only in server/current/learn/security/roles.md and have no entry in Capella's own access-control docs. Capella's documented model uses capella-role:* roles and the 27-member capella-advanced-access-* privilege catalogue, in which none of these names appear. A Capella reader following these prerequisites cannot look the named role up in any Capella page. Same shape as cloud-eventing-unadapted-server-content and capella-pages-cite-server-versions: shared SQL++ reference source carrying server-tree specifics into the Capella tree unadapted.
